The '''Republic Core Base''' was a military post of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the [[Battle of Cadinth]], the New Republic's [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Brin Stiels]] attempted to contact it in order to gain verification about the allegiance of units approaching his positions.
